title: Don't Stop, Reach For That Brilliance

text_block_list.text:
——It was late in the afternoon of a day off.
While out and about, I 
ran in to Ai.
She asked me to be her partner in a Quiz
Challenge duo.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
When I entered the shop,
there was a contest 
happening……If you answer all the question
correctly, 
you get a pair of Kyumaru dolls!
So please!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This cute and cozy Kappa carrying a
cucumber. 
Isn't it really cute♪?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've always really liked Kyumaru,
since a long time ago……so please!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
——You're the one that needs to answer the
next 
question,
Trainer. Let's believe in Beginner's Luck!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
And here's your question! This Kappa,
Kyumaru's—— 
Neighbor,
Uncle Puffin has a niece. What is the 
name of the clownfish she keeps as a pet?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a minute! 
That question is to core for
Trainer-san……!
choice_data_list: (Like hell I'd know～!!) Is it Tama...

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, that's incorrect! 
And so this challenge comes to an end!
Feel free to try again～!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating! To think they'd 
ask so many core questions like that!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, don't worry about it. 
A question like that,
I don't think most of 
even the die hard fans would be able to
answer it……

Almond Eye was trying to be considerate,
but it was pretty 
obvious by her expression that she was
frustrated at losing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ehh? Next time——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, will you go with me next time……?
choice_data_list: Of course. Let's get our revenge!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……!! Yeah, that's what I wanna hear! 
Next time we'll get all of them right!

We acted immediately on that idea. 
Almond Eye and I headed to a place to study
for the quiz ahead.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
At this Karaoke place,
you can even play videos. 
——Shall we watch some of the older Anime
movies together?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu……♪ Kyumaru really is cute, right? 
Really liking cucumbers,
I can sympathize with that.
choice_data_list: Is that why you like Kyumaru?
Is that why you like Kyumaru?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm……that's a part of it, but also, how,
in order to find his long-lost mother,
he's honestly working to 
get stronger to face any challenge that
comes his way.
choice_data_list: Straight for their goal……Just like Ai

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that might be it too. ……Ah,
look. I really 
recommend watching this scene!
The way Kyumaru 
musters up his courage for the sake of his
mother is great.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……Huh? 
Trainer, your eyes are kind of red,
you know? Are you okay?
choice_data_list: That last scene was so moving……

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that one, huh……! 
The first time I saw it,
my eyes welled up too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But……even though it's painful to be apart,
for his mother he continues 
his journey.
It was a story that reaffirmed Kyumaru's
strength.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
——Alright. Now that the movie is over,
let's review 
and think about some potential questions
that might 
show up on the quiz! That's our next step!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A Collab Cafe!
It's getting close to lunchtime 
so it'll be like two birds with one stone,
right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Earl Seal's cream pankcakes or Todosuke's
omelette soba——It was a 
really hard choice,
but getting them both was the correct
decision♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer's Greedy Plate is really cute
too……! 
Can I take a picture of it?

——And so the two of us enjoyed the Collab
menu. 
Once she had sated her hunger,
she took out her notebook.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've gathered all the Kyumaru info in
here! 
『Lets work hard and study together-Kyu～♪』,
just kidding.
choice_data_list: Oooh, you sound just like Kyumaru!
Oooh, you sound just like Kyumaru!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's really similar, right? 
They might have us do an impersonation so
we'll be perfectly ready!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The story episodes written on the tag is
different for 
each stuffed animal.
We need to keep that in mind too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get them all! 
We'll start with Kyumaru riding a
cucumber!
choice_data_list: (Pushing herself to the limit as u...

text_block_list.text:
Most people would probably think 『Do you
really need to go that far?』 
But Almond Eye was not afraid to take on
that challenge.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
——I did it! I got three at the same time! 
Fufufuu……it went just like I imagined!!

Always going full strength——
and always having fun.

Together at her side,
we'd go all out to get our revenge—— 
I have to put in the effort to match hers.

And so on the next day off,
we challenged the quiz again. 
Each of us has to alternate answering the
questions, one by one——
choice_data_list: Kyumaru looks up to Dancing Penguin!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The number of cucumbers on the 3rd Anniversary
Emblem? 
——3x3, so, of course 9!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Next is the final question! 
——The Onii-san over there, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Next is the final question! 
——The Onee-san over there, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Then,
in the movie 『Kyumaru's Grand Adventure』——

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
The multi-banded Butterfly Fish that appears
midway through,
how many bands does it have on its body? 
How many are on each side,
and how many are long and short?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, as expected of a last question…… 
You wouldn't know that unless you looked
very closely)
choice_data_list: On top, 2 on each side. 3 Long ones——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: And one short one under the fins!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
——Correct!! You were able to answer every 
question so you've completed this
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wow～ that was amazing!
For someone who only 
recently learned about Kyumaru,
that was a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Amazing……that was amazing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That was something we didn't even cover at
our 
last study session,
you know? You really studied……!
choice_data_list: Just like you, I hate losing
Just like you, I hate losing

text_block_list.text:
Seeing Almond Eye frustrated made me also
feel frustrated. 
If she wanted revenge,
then I wanted to help her——

That's why I studied even on my own, 
reviewing everything I learned from Almond
Eye.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Everything……from the movie we saw in the
karaoke booth, our 
chat in the cafe,
and what we studied together——all of that?

I also saw a few other movies as well after
that. 
They sometimes had me in tears——

And after enjoying the delicious food at
that collab cafe, 
I did a study session to attempt to do some
impersonations——

I reviewed all the places and things I'd
seen together with Almond Eye, 
preparing meticulously.
I went as deep in to the lore as I could.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: All of that for this revenge match……?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ——……I see……

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……Fufu. ……Fufuu……Fufu,
ahahahahaa! That's right. 
That's just……the kind of person you are!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! 
Thanks to you,
we were able to obtain the ultimate
victory.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! For Trainer too—— 
Here, one of the Kyumaru prizes
choice_data_list: It's fine for Ai to keep both

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No way! We won them together, 
so you should take one too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll treasure mine too. 
——It's a trophy to commemorate our revenge
victory♪
